policies.title: Permit to Work Policy
policies.summary: All non-routine, hazardous, or high-risk work activities require a valid Permit to Work (PTW) before commencement. PTW types include Hot Work, Confined Space Entry, Electrical Isolation, Working at Height, and Excavation.
policies.applicability: All contractors, subcontractors, and employees performing work on controlled sites
key_requirements: PTW must be issued by an authorized PTW issuer
All hazards must be identified and controls applied before work starts
Atmospheric testing required for confined space and hot work permits
PTW must be closed out and signed off on completion
Simultaneous operations (SIMOPS) must be reviewed by senior supervisor

policies.title: Stop Work Authority Policy
policies.summary: Any worker at any level has the right and responsibility to stop any work they believe presents an imminent danger to life, health, or the environment. No worker shall face retaliation for exercising Stop Work Authority (SWA).
key_requirements: All personnel must be trained on Stop Work Authority during induction
SWA exercises must be reported and documented
Work must not resume until hazard is resolved and authorized re-start is given
SWA near-misses are tracked as a leading indicator

policies.title: Management of Change Policy
policies.summary: All changes to processes, equipment, procedures, chemicals, staffing, or site layouts must be reviewed through the formal Management of Change (MOC) process before implementation.
key_requirements: MOC request must describe the nature of change and reason
Hazard identification and risk assessment must be updated for the change
Affected personnel must be trained before change is implemented
MOC must be approved by HSSE and engineering before sign-off
